newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Hoyts says finalising screen purchases.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Hoyts says finalising screen purchases.

text.p: Cinema operator Hoyts Cinema Group Ltd said on Thursday it was finalising the acquisition of 54 screens in New Jersey in the United States and was also exploring a number of growth opportunities in that area.

"Furthermore, we are finalising a 54 screen acquisitions in New Jersey and exploring a number of attractive growth opprotunities in that area," Hoyts chairman David Gonski told the group's annual general meeting.
Hoyts said it was now the 10th largest movie screen operator in the United States and had added an extra 62 new screens in New York, Maine and Vermont during the 1995/96 year.
"And we are on target for an additional 88 screens, including an 18-plex in Albany and Syracuse for the 1996/97 period," Gonski said.
He said Hoyts was currently working on a number of new projects and had under development and negotiation in excess of 1,500 new screens, of which 70 percent were in its existing market.

Hoyts earlier announced a A$61.1 capital raising to fund the purchase of a 35 percent stake in Mexican cinema developer Cinemex and to provide additional financial flexibility for the company's international growth plans.
Hoyts said it had signed an agreement to inject A$28 million into Cinemex over the next year.
